about: A whole cut into its parts as a pie or a ring, each slice arriving as it is named, with a legend of names and shares: proportions, budgets, make-up, who holds what share.

values.about: a size for each part; shares are worked out from them

highlight.about: parts to draw in the accent (the rest go quiet), split by |

ring.about: 1 draws a ring with room in the middle

middle.about: words in the ring's middle, such as the total

when.about: moments each slice arrives; else when its name is said, or one after another
